goal: 冻结 Task 5A ready-path 所缺的 active Exact authority source contract，防止在没有八项 canonical dependency vector 和 loadout-scoped occurrence relation 时猜测或启用 Exact runtime。
userValue: 玩家继续使用当前 SimC 页面时，系统只会在完整可重放 authority 存在时创建 Exact 任务；缺少事实会诚实地保持 blocked，而不会产生貌似成功的旧链路结果。
nonGoals: 不实现或启用 active authority provider、Exact runtime、candidate、生产 migration、worker activation、API cutover 或 SimC runner。
不修改现有前端 UI 的 route、JSX hierarchy、文案、SCSS、入口、导航或 target。
不修改 Catalog/Manifest pointer、generation 35、Task 6C observation/admission、0030--0034 migration，或既有 Task 3A、3B、4W、5A evidence identity。
不把 Catalog membership、compatibility context、latest row、process constant、client input 或 HTTP success 当作 Exact authority。

executionAuthorization.promotionRule: This is a requirement challenge, not an implementation authorization. A separately approved Strict task must name one immutable runtime release, one occurrence-index authority and their owner/ACL/candidate/rollback evidence before runtime code may be changed.

releaseSlices.scope: Document the missing runtime release, resolver-context and loadout-occurrence authority contracts and their fail-closed conditions.
releaseSlices.gate: No provider, migration, candidate or runtime consumer may be implemented until each named source is immutable, uniquely keyed, typed-reloadable and independently authorized.

mustChange: Only the Task 5B control-plane plan, plan index, roadmap/resequence status and this requirement contract.
mustNotChange: All runtime source, UI source, database migrations, deployments, worker/service state, Catalog/Manifest/generation 35 state and archived task evidence.
riskUnknown: No current immutable authority release proves all eight job dependency identities.
No current active owner uniquely maps a first-pass loadout subject signature to its governed sealed effect record.
Any attempt to bridge either gap from a mutable pointer, latest row or client data would violate Exact-first truth.
evidenceRequired: A later independent plan must identify one immutable source and RED/GREEN tests for eight-field vector, resolver context, occurrence index, exact bytes/key/hash reload, role boundaries and literal blocked outcomes.
A later cloud-only disposable PostgreSQL candidate, production rollback evidence and four existing-page real-WeChat acceptance items remain required before user-visible closure.

ownership.factOwner: No active fact owner exists yet for the complete runtime release and occurrence index. Task 5A remains the owner of request orchestration only and must fail closed until a separately authorized authority owner exists.
ownership.privacyBoundary: No raw profile, player identity, realm/server data or user UUID may enter an authority release, occurrence index, job, snapshot, log, artifact or public envelope.

engineeringHealth.reason: The source audit proves that 0033 replays template-to-slot-bundle relations and 0031 persists only completed aggregates; neither can determine the missing eight-field vector or dynamically scoped support record relation.

acceptanceEvidence: This requirement truthfully preserves the fail-closed boundary and names the exact source/owner evidence needed before implementation.
No code, runtime state, candidate resource, CI loop or user-facing claim is created by this Task 5B control-plane slice.

candidateDeployment.beforeMerge: Not applicable: Task 5B changes only current control-plane documentation and creates no runtime tree.
candidateDeployment.afterMerge: No candidate or production action is authorized. A successor Strict task will require a cloud-only disposable candidate before any merge that changes runtime behavior.
candidateDeployment.rollback: Revert the documentation commit if needed; current Exact HTTP behavior remains fail closed and no remote state exists.

closureCondition: Task 5B can close as a requirement challenge only after the current documents accurately record that no active authority source exists. It does not close Task 5A, Task 6C, candidate validation, production activation or the player-visible Exact-first journey.

decisionLog.decision: After Task 5A local source/profile/job/client binding work, a source audit found no immutable active runtime release with all eight dependency identities and no owner-scoped occurrence index for dynamic loadout effect records. The next task is therefore a requirement challenge rather than an inferred runtime implementation.
The user continues to require backend integration with the existing UI only; this contract preserves that UI unchanged and does not authorize a fallback to legacy analyzer behavior.
